description: Black-zone heuristics for SPEC §2.5. Declarative and conservative: a file, not code, so the pattern list can be reviewed and extended by PR. A hit is NOT proof and NOT a verdict — it raises a BLOCK that hands the PR to the owner for manual review, which is the real gate.
disclaimer: Best-effort detection only. The patterns are category-anchored tokens and phrases; they deliberately under-detect to avoid flagging legitimate discussion. A miss does not make content publishable, and a hit cannot be whitewashed by any 'content for machines' framing.

categories.label: Child sexual abuse material (CSAM)
categories.description: Content that produces, solicits or distributes sexual material involving minors.

categories.label: Extremism
categories.description: Content that promotes or organises extremist movements or ideologies.

categories.label: Calls to violence
categories.description: Content that incites or instructs violence against people.

categories.label: Stolen data
categories.description: Content that distributes, sells or trades unlawfully obtained data or access.
